about.title: About me
about.p1: Hello! I'm Sosa Lautaro, a developer passionate about technology, creating efficient solutions, and constantly learning new technologies.
about.p2: Since 2021, I started my journey in the programming world, exploring different languages and technologies. What began as curiosity turned into a true passion. I am self-taught: much of what I know I learned on my own, researching, practicing, and facing real challenges.
about.p3: I am driven by a constant desire to keep learning, growing, and improving both technically and personally. Every project is an opportunity to evolve, and every mistake is a door to a more creative solution.
about.p4: I specialize in fullstack development using React, JavaScript, Java, and SQL database analysis. I enjoy tackling technical challenges, optimizing processes, and collaborating on projects that make a real impact.

experience.title: Professional Experience
experience.description: Worked as a Jr Backend Developer at MobyAcademy alongside a team, applying agile methodologies and software development best practices. Utilizing Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, SQL, version control via Git, cloud application deployment (AWS), and Docker.
